about: The versions the user chose by ear in the Gallery's Sounds tab. Each pick names a candidate of the sound (an ElevenLabs take from 101, a stock recording from 1): the game plays it by default, ahead of the sound's measured default, and the Gallery lists it first as "Pick". A browser's own pick still wins. docs/ui/SOUND.md "Choosing between recordings".
